macros.name: displayChoices
macros.doc: The \displayChoices command displays the choices made in the console window of AA/AR, while \clrChoices clears all the marginal checkboxes.

macros.name: InputItems
macros.doc: \InputItems: Sets the input mode to input items in a list environment.

macros.name: InputParas
macros.doc: \InputParas: Sets the input mode to input ‘paragraph content’.

macros.name: InputProbs
macros.doc: \InputProbs: Set the input mode to input problems for an exam created by the eqexam package.

macros.name: InputQuizItems
macros.doc: \InputQuizItems: Sets the input mode to input items in a quiz (as created by the quiz environment).

macros.name: pmCBPresets
macros.doc: The document produces checkboxes in the margins, you can set the appearance of the checkboxes using the \pmCBPresets command.

macros.name: pmInput
macros.doc: When content is input by \pmInput, a checkbox is created in the margin at the insertion point of the content.

macros.name: useEditBtn
macros.doc: We provide a control for setting the annot used to edit the source: \useEditBtn, a pushbutton is used; \useEditLnk, a link is used.

macros.name: useEditLnk
macros.doc: Expanding \useEditLnk replaces the marginal pushbutton with a link annotation.
